Description.Name: Spine Hardening
Description.Details: With the secondary supports at full strength, the Argo's spine can be hardened to carry the extra mass of a fully crewed Beta Lance bay and the strain of a GN drive's output. Bracing frames, new load paths and refitted joints run the length of the hull.

AssignedCastDescription: Commander, the spine will hold what we've built, but not much more. If you want a sixth bay on Beta Lance or a GN drive in the engine room, we'll need to harden the whole length of it first.
